content: Aɣelleb n Asa, ajeǧid n Yahuda, x Zaraḥ
Asa igga min iǧan nican di tiṭṭawin n SIDI, AREBBI nnes.
Netta ikkes iɛalṭaren n irebbiten iɣriben d řegɛudi uca yarẓa imayḍuten iqeddsen uca ihdem tirebbin n cwarti.
Netta inna i Yahuda, ad arzun SIDI, AREBBI n řejdud nsen uca ad ḍfaren Ccariɛa d tewṣeyyet.
Netta ikkes ɛawed řegɛudi d ipilaren n arebbi n tfuct zi marra tineddam n Yahuda. Tageldit tuɣa ɣares řhudnet sadu netta.
Ibna tineddam ifaryen di Yahuda maɣar tammurt tuɣa dayes řhudnet. War tuɣi din amenɣi akides deg iseggʷusa nni, minzi SIDI iwca as řhudnet.

Netta inna i Yahuda: “Ejj aneɣ ad nebna tineddam-a uca ad tent nessar s řeḥyuḍ d lburjat d tewwura d iɛumad i ubelleɛ, maɣar tammurt ɛad zzatneɣ s řhudnet, minzi neccin narzu x SIDI, AREBBI nneɣ, narzu xas u Netta iwca aneɣ řhudnet.” U nitni bnan uca feřḥen.

Asa tuɣa ɣares ijj n řɛeskar n teřt-myat-ařef n yeryazen zi Yahuda, inni iksin taseddart n uɛeskari tameqqrant d lansa, mitayen u-tmenyin-ařef n yeryazen zi Binyamin, inni yarebbun taseddart n uɛeskari u zemmaren x řqews. Nitni marra tuɣa aten d ayt n bu-teɣruḍt imeḥḍen.
Iffeɣ Akuci, qqaren as Zaraḥ i umenɣi akidsen s yijj n řɛeskar n ijj n melyun n yeryazen d teřt-mya n ikarruten. Netta yusa-dd ař Marica.
Iffeɣ Asa i umsagar akides uca sedden nitni ixef nsen i umenɣi di teɣzurt n Ṣafata ɣar Marica.

Asa iřaɣa ɣar SIDI, AREBBI nnes, inna: “A SIDI, aya isheř xak ḥima ad tadfed jar yenni deg waṭṭas d yenni war ɣar iǧi jjehd. Ɛawen aneɣ, a SIDI, AREBBI nneɣ, maɣar nettceř xak u nusa-dd qibač i řɣaci-ya s Yisem nnec. A SIDI, Cek d AREBBI nneɣ, war ttejji uřa d ijj n weryaz ad akidek immɛařa.”
Uca SIDI iwta ayt n Kuc zzat i wudem n Asa d Yahuda, uca arewřen ayt n Kuc.

Asa d řgens i tuɣa akides, ḍfaren ten ař Jarar. Wḍan aṭṭas zeg ayt n Kuc ařami war zemmaren ad bedden ɛad, minzi nitni ttwaɣeřben zzat i wudem n SIDI d řɛeskar nnes. Nitni ṭṭfen ict n tkeccaḍt d tameqqrant.
Nitni wtin marra tineddam i dd-innḍen i Jarar, maɣar arrehbet n SIDI tewḍa-dd xasent. Nitni keccḍen marra tineddam, maɣar tuɣa tban-dd daysent aṭṭas n tkeccaḍt.
Nitni hedmen uřa d iqiḍan n řmař uca ṭṭfen uǧi d iřeɣman. Xenni ɛeqben ɣar Urcalim.
